chapter_title_en: The Wrath of the Endless Furnace
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 453: The Shaoyin Founder & His Monstrous Insects Attack!
chapter_meta_description: The Shaoyin clan’s ultimate founder arrives with three monstrous beasts. Ji Ning faces eight Celestial Immortals as an ancient furnace begins to stir. A clash of titans!
og_title: The Horned King Arrives – Desolate Era 453
og_description: Ji Ning’s siege has drawn out the Shaoyin clan’s highest power. Can even his Six-Armed Fiendgod body withstand the founder’s insect army?
twitter_title: The Clan Founder Shows His Hand – Desolate Era Ch. 453
twitter_description: The golden-robed horned man is here, and he’s brought three terrifying gigantic insect beasts. Ji Ning isn’t backing down!

lore_anchors.definition: The founder of the Shaoyin clan, a Celestial Immortal famous for his numerous clones and terrifying poison insect minions, making him a notoriously difficult being to kill.

The ancient artifact buried beneath the Shaoyin clan's ancestral domain, identified by the clan founder. Its full nature and purpose are still mysterious, but it is clearly a core foundation of the clan's power.

The supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained by mastering nine cycles of body refinement; requires enormous treasure resources to advance but provides indestructibility without consuming divine power.
A classic Fiendgod divine ability that physically manifests extra heads and arms, allowing the cultivator to exponentially increase their close-quarters combat lethality.
A top-ten divine ability since Pangu, created by Daoist Threelives; allows the cultivator to use their hands as ultimate weapons, shattering defenses that would resist flying swords.
